Markus / team — forwarding Amy’s note from Globex. CTO wants to join for 12:00–12:30 PT. Two things to consider:

Options (quick):
1) Move the whole demo 60 minutes later to 12:00–1:00 PT — preserves live demo and CTO overlap.
2) Keep original 11:00 slot and schedule a 25-min deep-dive at 12:15 PT with the CTO (shorter, systems-focused).
3) Split: run a 30-min high-level demo at 11:00 then an optional 30-min technical session at 12:00 for the CTO and engineers.

Tradeoffs:
- Option 1 is simplest for Globex but may conflict with other prospects; it’s preferable for executive presence.
- Option 2 minimizes calendar churn but requires an engineer on standby for the 12:15 follow-up.
- Option 3 is heavier on ops but gives both audiences what they need.

I’ve attached a quick slot table with team availability for Nov 24 ([Attachment: proposed_slot_table.csv]). Suggest we aim for Option 1 if Markus can move — Laura can take lead on the agenda compression to fit into 45 minutes if needed.

Markus — can you confirm if you and the demo engineer (Tessa) can shift? Tessa — if we compress, can you shorten the live demo to 15 minutes and keep one deep system slide? Monica — can you own follow-up scheduling if we do the split?

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: proposed_slot_table.csv]

- If Peter wants an additional deep systems discussion, we can run a 20-minute follow-up same day at 1:00 PM PT.
